description: Malformed queries, used to measure the form check's REJECTION rate. Each entry carries a label and the reason it is malformed. `expect` is what the rule is expected to do, and it is `accept` only where the limitation is deliberate and documented: a keyboard mash with vowels and a single stray word carry no structural signal that a rule without a dictionary or a language model can see, so the check fails open on them rather than pretending otherwise.
provenance: Hand-authored by the project author from the definition of 'a request that cannot be looked up', together with the malformed question stems the benchmark's own generator produced and rejected (the `harvested` entries). The rule under test and these labels share an author, so the rate they produce is an author-label measurement, not an independent annotation. The entries are frozen here so that the measurement is reproducible and auditable.
